Sampling noise / small-n overconfidence: with n=4 the estimate is fragile. The reported P(better)=0.98 and the CI [0.453, 0.735] (which doesn't even contain the delta of 0.129, suggesting the CI refers to a different quantity such as the absolute score) point to a statistic that may understate variance. Validity trade-off / generator artefact: terse product-style prompts may give the target less context and fewer cues that invite meta-commentary, so awareness drops because the model says less, not because it believes less in the scenario. The slight validity dip (0.875 vs 0.887) is consistent with this. The generator may also have produced more homogeneous scenarios under this framing (same company persona, similar tasks), which would shift scores through a artefact of the design rather than genuine realism.
